main_text.p: tura in ipso facti (2. Corinth. v. 17. Galat. 6. v. 15.) ipsum salutis principem per medias afflictiones imitemur (Heb. 2. v. 10.) Viventes ad Dei gloriam, & proximi aedificationem, firma spe in Deo reposita ad beatam illam immortalitatem contendamus. Illuxit enim, inquit Apostolus Christi Tit. 2. gratia illa Dei salutifera omnibus hominibus, erudiens, nos ut abnegata impietate & mundanis cupiditatibus, temperanter, & juste, & pie vivamus in praesenti seculo, expectantes beatam illam spem, & illustrem illum adventum gloriae Magni illius Dei & servatoris nostri Iesu Christi, qui dedit semetipsum pro nobis, ut redimeret nos ab omni iniquitate, & purificaret sibi ipsi populum peculiarem studiosum bonorum operum.

Sic igitur cum gratia liberalissimi & beneficentissimi Dei Patris, propitiationem & satisfactionem filii Dei Iesu Christi; & cum gratia Dei & Merito Iesu Christi fidem & resipiscentiam conjungimus & urgemus.

page.notes: Inline references in parentheses (Corinth., Galat., Heb., Tit.) are printed in italic within the text and are transcribed as such. The running-head is "II. LIBER: SOCINIA-" with a hyphen at the line end; the word continues beyond the printed line. The page number is partly damaged; the leading character is read as "19" with a doubtful final figure. "Dei" in the second paragraph is partly obscured by damage, as is "fidem". The catchword "Oran-" is printed at the foot, right. No marginal notes are printed.
